name: Cibakháza (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Cibakháza: a blue and yellow shield with a lion, a bunch of grapes, flowers and waves, with a helm, a crest and red and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Cibakháza arms with helm, crest and mantling
